name: dropdown-menu
title: Dropdown Menu
description: Displays a menu to the user — such as a set of actions or functions — triggered by a button.
usageSnippet:
static const ITEMS = [
  { value: "profile", label: "Profile" },
  { value: "settings", label: "Settings" },
  { type: "separator" },
  { value: "logout", label: "Log out" },
] satisfies DropdownMenuItem[];

<DropdownMenu items=ITEMS select(value) { /* ... */ }>
  <@trigger|triggerProps|>
    <Button variant="outline" ...triggerProps>Open</Button>
  </@trigger>
</DropdownMenu>

attributes.name: inset
attributes.description: Emits `data-inset` — indents the entry to align with icon-bearing siblings.

attributes.name: radioGroup
attributes.description: Groups radio items — required for `type: "radio"` entries.

attributes.name: radioValue
attributes.description: `type: "radio"` entries only — this entry's value within its `radioGroup`.

attributes.name: subEntries
attributes.description: `type: "sub"` entries only — the nested submenu's own item list. One level deep: a `type: "sub"` entry inside a submenu's own `subEntries` is not wired (same limit as menubar's submenu).

props.name: positioning
props.description:
Machine pass-throughs, forwarded to `@zag-js/menu` by `<zag-machine ...
from=input/>` regardless of whether they're declared here (see
`buildMachineProps` in marko-zag) — declared for type safety and DX.
`positioning`/`onHighlightChange` are what a caller needs to relocate the
popup (side/align/gutter/mobile anchor override) and mirror the
highlighted item for a hover-preview, the two capabilities the typeset/
create picker.marko files used to hand-roll a whole parallel menu for.

events.name: checkedChange
events.description: Fires when a checkbox item's checked state changes; receives its value and new checked state.

events.name: radioChange
events.description: Fires when a radio group's selected value changes; receives the group name and new value.

keyboard.description: Opens the menu when focused on the trigger; activates the highlighted item when the menu is open.
Moves the highlight to the next / previous item, wrapping at the ends.
On a submenu trigger item, opens the submenu and moves focus into it.
Closes an open submenu (ArrowLeft) or the whole menu (Escape) and returns focus to the trigger.
Moves the highlight to the first / last item.
Typeahead: jumps the highlight to the next item whose label starts with the typed characters.

accessibilityNotes: The trigger and content wire up `aria-haspopup`, `aria-expanded`, and `aria-controls` automatically via the underlying Zag menu machine — no manual ARIA authoring needed.
Checkbox and radio items expose `role="menuitemcheckbox"` / `role="menuitemradio"` with `aria-checked` reflecting the `checked` field.
Disabled items (`disabled: true`) are marked `aria-disabled` and skipped by both keyboard navigation and typeahead.

examples.title: Basic
examples.source:
import DropdownMenu from "@marko-ui/shadcn/ui/dropdown-menu/dropdown-menu.marko";
import type { DropdownMenuItem } from "@marko-ui/shadcn/ui/dropdown-menu/dropdown-menu.marko";
import Button from "@marko-ui/shadcn/ui/button/button.marko";

static const ITEMS = [
  { type: "label", label: "My Account" },
  { type: "separator" },
  { value: "profile", label: "Profile", shortcut: "⇧⌘P" },
  { value: "billing", label: "Billing", shortcut: "⌘B" },
  { value: "settings", label: "Settings", shortcut: "⌘S" },
  { type: "separator" },
  { value: "team", label: "Team" },
  { value: "invite", label: "Invite users", disabled: true },
  { type: "separator" },
  { value: "logout", label: "Log out", variant: "destructive" },
] satisfies DropdownMenuItem[];

<DropdownMenu items=ITEMS>
  <@trigger|triggerProps|>
    <Button type="button" variant="outline" ...triggerProps>Open</Button>
  </@trigger>
</DropdownMenu>
examples.description: Items are a plain array — mix labels, separators, shortcuts, and a destructive item without composing subcomponents.

examples.title: Submenu
examples.source:
import DropdownMenu from "@marko-ui/shadcn/ui/dropdown-menu/dropdown-menu.marko";
import type { DropdownMenuItem } from "@marko-ui/shadcn/ui/dropdown-menu/dropdown-menu.marko";
import Button from "@marko-ui/shadcn/ui/button/button.marko";

static const ITEMS = [
  { value: "team", label: "Team" },
  {
    type: "sub",
    label: "Invite users",
    subEntries: [
      { value: "email", label: "Email" },
      { value: "message", label: "Message" },
      { type: "separator" },
      { value: "calendly", label: "Calendly" },
      { value: "slack", label: "Slack" },
      { type: "separator" },
      { value: "webhook", label: "Webhook" },
      { type: "separator" },
      { value: "advanced", label: "Advanced..." },
    ],
  },
  { value: "new-team", label: "New Team", shortcut: "⌘+T" },
] satisfies DropdownMenuItem[];

<DropdownMenu items=ITEMS>
  <@trigger|triggerProps|>
    <Button type="button" variant="outline" ...triggerProps>Open</Button>
  </@trigger>
</DropdownMenu>
examples.description: A `type: "sub"` entry with its own `subEntries` nests a secondary menu. Our submenu wiring supports one level of nesting: a `type: "sub"` entry inside a submenu's own `subEntries` is not wired, so upstream's second-level 'More options' items (Calendly, Slack, Webhook) are flattened directly into the 'Invite users' submenu instead of sitting behind their own nested trigger.

examples.title: Checkboxes with icons
examples.source:
import DropdownMenu from "@marko-ui/shadcn/ui/dropdown-menu/dropdown-menu.marko";
import Button from "@marko-ui/shadcn/ui/button/button.marko";
import Icon from "@marko-ui/shadcn/ui/icon/icon.marko";

<let/email=true/>
<let/sms=false/>
<let/push=true/>

<DropdownMenu
  select(value) {
    if (value === "email") email = !email;
    else if (value === "sms") sms = !sms;
    else if (value === "push") push = !push;
  }
  class="w-48"
>
  <@trigger|triggerProps|>
    <Button type="button" variant="outline" ...triggerProps>Notifications</Button>
  </@trigger>
  <@item type="label" label="Notification Preferences"/>
  <@item type="checkbox" value="email" checked=email>
    <Icon name="Mail"/>
    Email notifications
  </@item>
  <@item type="checkbox" value="sms" checked=sms>
    <Icon name="MessageSquareIcon"/>
    SMS notifications
  </@item>
  <@item type="checkbox" value="push" checked=push>
    <Icon name="BellIcon"/>
    Push notifications
  </@item>
</DropdownMenu>
examples.description: Checkbox items can carry an icon before the label, same as regular items.

examples.title: Radio group
examples.source:
import DropdownMenu from "@marko-ui/shadcn/ui/dropdown-menu/dropdown-menu.marko";
import type { DropdownMenuItem } from "@marko-ui/shadcn/ui/dropdown-menu/dropdown-menu.marko";
import Button from "@marko-ui/shadcn/ui/button/button.marko";

<let/position="bottom"/>

<const/items=[
  { type: "label", label: "Panel Position" },
  { type: "radio", value: "top", label: "Top", checked: position === "top", radioGroup: "position" },
  { type: "radio", value: "bottom", label: "Bottom", checked: position === "bottom", radioGroup: "position" },
  { type: "radio", value: "right", label: "Right", checked: position === "right", radioGroup: "position" },
] satisfies DropdownMenuItem[]/>

<DropdownMenu
  items=items
  select(value) { position = value; }
  class="w-32"
>
  <@trigger|triggerProps|>
    <Button type="button" variant="outline" ...triggerProps>Open</Button>
  </@trigger>
</DropdownMenu>
examples.description: `type: "radio"` entries sharing a `radioGroup` name behave as an exclusive choice.

examples.title: Complex
examples.source:
import DropdownMenu from "@marko-ui/shadcn/ui/dropdown-menu/dropdown-menu.marko";
import Button from "@marko-ui/shadcn/ui/button/button.marko";
import Icon from "@marko-ui/shadcn/ui/icon/icon.marko";

<let/showSidebar=true/>
<let/showStatusBar=false/>
<let/theme="light"/>

<DropdownMenu
  select(value) {
    if (value === "show-sidebar") showSidebar = !showSidebar;
    else if (value === "show-status-bar") showStatusBar = !showStatusBar;
    else if (value === "light" || value === "dark" || value === "system") theme = value;
  }
  class="w-44"
>
  <@trigger|triggerProps|>
    <Button type="button" variant="outline" ...triggerProps>Complex Menu</Button>
  </@trigger>

  <@item type="label" label="File"/>
  <@item value="new-file" shortcut="⌘N">
    <Icon name="FileIcon"/>
    New File
  </@item>
  <@item value="new-folder" shortcut="⇧⌘N">
    <Icon name="FolderIcon"/>
    New Folder
  </@item>
  <@item
    type="sub"
    label="Open Recent"
    subEntries=[
      { type: "label", label: "Recent Projects" },
      { value: "project-alpha", label: "Project Alpha" },
      { value: "project-beta", label: "Project Beta" },
      { type: "separator" },
      { value: "project-gamma", label: "Project Gamma" },
      { value: "project-delta", label: "Project Delta" },
      { type: "separator" },
      { value: "browse", label: "Browse..." },
    ]
  />
  <@item type="separator"/>
  <@item value="save" shortcut="⌘S">
    <Icon name="SaveIcon"/>
    Save
  </@item>
  <@item value="export" shortcut="⇧⌘E">
    <Icon name="DownloadIcon"/>
    Export
  </@item>
  <@item type="separator"/>

  <@item type="label" label="View"/>
  <@item type="checkbox" value="show-sidebar" checked=showSidebar>
    <Icon name="EyeIcon"/>
    Show Sidebar
  </@item>
  <@item type="checkbox" value="show-status-bar" checked=showStatusBar>
    <Icon name="LayoutIcon"/>
    Show Status Bar
  </@item>
  <@item
    type="sub"
    label="Theme"
    subEntries=[
      { type: "label", label: "Appearance" },
      { type: "radio", value: "light", label: "Light", radioGroup: "theme", checked: theme === "light" },
      { type: "radio", value: "dark", label: "Dark", radioGroup: "theme", checked: theme === "dark" },
      { type: "radio", value: "system", label: "System", radioGroup: "theme", checked: theme === "system" },
    ]
  />
  <@item type="separator"/>

  <@item type="label" label="Account"/>
  <@item value="profile" shortcut="⇧⌘P">
    <Icon name="User"/>
    Profile
  </@item>
  <@item value="billing">
    <Icon name="CreditCard"/>
    Billing
  </@item>
  <@item
    type="sub"
    label="Settings"
    subEntries=[
      { type: "label", label: "Preferences" },
      { value: "keyboard-shortcuts", label: "Keyboard Shortcuts" },
      { value: "language", label: "Language" },
      { type: "separator" },
      { type: "label", label: "Notification Types" },
      { value: "push-notifications", label: "Push Notifications" },
      { value: "email-notifications", label: "Email Notifications" },
      { type: "separator" },
      { value: "privacy", label: "Privacy & Security" },
    ]
  />
  <@item type="separator"/>

  <@item value="help">
    <Icon name="HelpCircleIcon"/>
    Help & Support
  </@item>
  <@item value="docs">
    <Icon name="FileTextIcon"/>
    Documentation
  </@item>
  <@item type="separator"/>
  <@item value="sign-out" shortcut="⇧⌘Q" variant="destructive">
    <Icon name="LogOutIcon"/>
    Sign Out
  </@item>
</DropdownMenu>
examples.description: A richer menu combining groups, icons, checkboxes, a radio group, and submenus. Two technically-forced omissions: nesting is one level deep (upstream nests a third level in two places — 'Open Recent' > 'More Projects', 'Settings' > 'Notifications' — so each nested submenu's items are flattened into its parent, in order, with a separator marking the old nesting point), and icons cannot appear inside a submenu or on a `type: 'sub'` trigger (`subEntries` is plain `DropdownMenuItem[]`, and the sub branch renders its trigger as a plain string with no body slot) — which is why 'New File', 'Save' and 'Profile' keep their icons while 'Open Recent', 'Theme' and 'Settings' do not.

examples.title: Compound (attr tags)
examples.source:
import DropdownMenu from "@marko-ui/shadcn/ui/dropdown-menu/dropdown-menu.marko";
import Button from "@marko-ui/shadcn/ui/button/button.marko";

<DropdownMenu>
  <@trigger|triggerProps|>
    <Button type="button" variant="outline" ...triggerProps>Actions</Button>
  </@trigger>
  <@item value="edit" shortcut="⌘E">Edit</@item>
  <@item value="duplicate" label="Duplicate"/>
  <@item value="archive" label="Archive"/>
  <@item type="separator"/>
  <@item value="delete" label="Delete" variant="destructive"/>
</DropdownMenu>
examples.description: Use `<@item>` attribute tags instead of `items=` to compose the menu directly in markup — pass `type="separator"` for a divider or `type="label"` for a group label. Entries render in the order they are written. An item's text can come from either a `label=` attribute or a markup body, whichever you prefer.

examples.description: A `dir="rtl"` wrapper with Arabic content, matching the precedent set by button/avatar/input's RTL demos.
